text: jayden is 9 he has epilepsy and a VNS implant, if he starts a seizure swipe the magnet (on his wrist band) over the left side of his chest. rescue med is Nayzilam nasal spray, 1 spray, can give a 2nd spray after 10 min if hes still seizing. call 911 at 5 min. we used to have diastat but we dont use that anymore so ignore it if its in old paperwork. hes a great kid loves pokemon and jokes
